integrity_notes: Mathematical derivation uses exact real arithmetic and analytical Gaussian integral identities.
Independent scientific audit and external priority verification have not been performed.
limitations: Exactly two fixed affine scalar probes symmetrically spaced about the true root; this is a local projection benchmark rather than an implementable probe-selection strategy.
Independent equal-variance Gaussian measurement errors; one projection stage without subsequent Anderson mixing.
Not a global risk optimum among all estimators, and not a result on a nonlinear or multistep solver.
title: Sharp Gaussian noise calibration of a depth-one Anderson projection
